map.估算结果用于作业方案与力量调配参考，不代表精确作业耗时。: The estimate is for reference in work planning and force allocation and does not represent the precise working time.
map.救援前按材质、厚度与工具类型估算破拆耗时，规划进攻与救人节奏。: Before rescue, estimate the breaching time from material, thickness and tool type to plan the attack and rescue pace.
map.对比不同难度系数下的破拆速度，选择最优工具组合。: Compare the breaching speed under different difficulty factors to choose the best tool combination.
